title: mixer: several sounds at once, ducking, no gaps (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Two sounds play together (a radio and a notification or chime) and both are heard, without the sum distorting.

steps.do: Start a radio station, then play a chime or notification sound while it plays.
steps.expect: Both are heard together. Neither is cut off, and the sum is not harsh or crackling.

clauses.text: A notification ducks the media: the radio or music fades down with the notification and fades back up after it.

steps.do: Keep a radio station or a music file playing and trigger a notification sound.
steps.expect: The media fades down while the notification plays and fades back up after it. It does not jump.

clauses.text: Long playback has no clicks, gaps or drop-outs.

steps.do: Play a music file or a radio station for about two minutes with another window in front.
steps.expect: The sound is continuous: no clicks, gaps or repeated bits. Note where any gap happens.

clauses.text: A 44.1 kHz file is resampled to the card's 48 kHz and keeps its pitch and speed.

steps.do: Play a 44.1 kHz music file, then a 48 kHz one, one after the other.
steps.expect: Both sound natural, at the pitch and speed they should have, with no crackle at the change.

clauses.text: The sound card is opened only while something plays and recovers after it was busy.

steps.do: Stop all sound and wait about ten seconds, then start a radio station again.
steps.expect: The sound starts normally without a long delay.

clauses.text: Closing the player ends its sounds at once; nothing keeps playing after it is closed.

steps.do: Start a radio station, then sign out.
steps.expect: The sound stops at once and nothing continues after sign-out.
